After nearly 3 years, I present to you our next music video, MUGA MILLION. Thank you guys so much for 1 million subscribers, so excited for the future Muga Adventures!

This song wouldn't have been possible without my brother MARCUS @IlysianOfficial aswell as IAN @Akayo_Music who helped produce 90% of the song. Aswell as the help of my mom, dad, and all my friends who joined in to help make this cinema. And of course, all of you guys!
